note: Transcribed from Hongjiacheng's own datasheets as served by LCSC (no manufacturer-hosted copy was located; LIBRARY.md section 2 fallback, as for BZT52C5V6). polarity: page 1 of every sheet: 'Polarity: Cathode line denotes the cathode end'; the outline drawing puts the cathode band on the left in top view, which is pad 1 at -x on the land
